text: Rēctē. Multō ablātīvus mēnsūrae differentiae est. Quantum aetātēs differant indicat; senior comparātiōnem tenet.
Rēctē. Paulō mēnsūram parvam differentiae indicat; senior aetātem maiōrem exprimit.
Rēctē. Tribus annīs differentiam aetātum mēnsūrat, nōn tempus ante praesēns indicat.
Rēctē. Duōbus pedibus excessum altitūdinis mūrī suprā turrim indicat, nōn tōtam altitūdinem.
Vocābula in extrēmā parte sectiōnis probantur.
